label: Grandstream GWN7801
description: Grandstream GWN7801 - 10-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 2x 1G SFP uplinks, no PoE. 20 Gbps switching capacity, 10 Gbps non-blocking, 14.88 Mpps, 4.1 Mb packet buffer, fanless 300 mm desktop case, managed by web UI, CLI and GDMS Networking / GWN Manager.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 20 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 10 Gbps, forwarding rate 14.88 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet table: 8 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 2x 1G SFP ports, 1 console, integrated power supply 30 W, 1x reset pinhole, no PoE ports on this SKU. 300 x 175 x 44 mm, 1.8 kg, fanless, desktop/wall/rack mount. RJ45 console at 115200 8-N-1 drops into the CLI (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/grandstream-network-switches-faq/), so cli is declared. Management is web UI, CLI and GDMS Networking / GWN Manager; the datasheet lists HTTPS, SSH and Telnet, so http-server and cli are the modelled capabilities. Layer 2+ only: no static routing is listed for the GWN7801/GWN7802/GWN7803 SKUs, so l3-forward is not declared. Firmware (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/gwn-management-platforms-user-guide/): minimum 1.0.3.19 (1.0.5.52 with GWN Manager), recommended 1.0.5.52.
